runner.syntax: source text statically inspected; no runner execution

runner_only_delta.details: The diff from run_frozen_checks.py contains only the explicit pytest configuration arguments; selection, environment, source provenance probe, evidence capture and count parsing are otherwise unchanged.

pytest_source_and_config_lock.details: Every full, independent and backup invocation uses the same constructed argv with cwd=<source>, the candidate's <source>/pyproject.toml, --rootdir=<source>, and pythonpath=<source>/src. This prevents pytest from selecting the repository-root pyproject or prepending the root editable src path when the selected harness lives under ROOT/.work.

environment_source_lock.details: The subprocess environment also sets PYTHONPATH=<source>/src and the existing offline/no-bytecode/plugin-autoload controls. The explicit pytest option and environment agree on the stopped candidate source.

module_provenance_probe.details: Before pytest, the supplied interpreter imports the ten named product modules from cwd=<source> and requires their reported paths to be under <source>/src. The final record must still retain the exact probe output and bind the stopped source snapshot as required by the R2 review.

suite_selection.details: full selects the stopped source tests directory; independent selects the 13 fixed architect harnesses; backup selects the separate T2 backup harness. The new arguments precede all selected paths.

freeze_prebinding.details: The revised freeze requires an explicit --freeze and --expected-full-tests, requires lane 3/revision 5, records the r2 orchestrator hash, expected full count, integration freeze row and standalone Unicode harness row.

inherited_controls_still_required.summary: The runner records JUnit counts but does not itself require 125 independent cases, 21 backup cases, the expected full count, or zero failures/errors/skips.
inherited_controls_still_required.required_control: The parent final acceptance must compare every run's counts with the frozen expected values, require zero failures/errors/skips and exit code zero, and bind the records to the same frozen manifest. The revised freeze's expected_full_tests_per_python field supplies the expected value but does not replace this comparison.

inherited_controls_still_required.summary: The runner accepts an arbitrary --python and does not enforce that separate full runs use the locked 3.12.14 and 3.13.13 executables.
inherited_controls_still_required.required_control: The parent must run both recorded locked interpreters, retain their resolved paths and versions, and bind each result to the same frozen source snapshot and manifest.

inherited_controls_still_required.summary: The runner trusts the supplied manifest's file rows and owner_inputs; it does not independently enforce the complete 26-path allowlist or all ready/acceptance fields.
inherited_controls_still_required.required_control: Use the revised freeze output and independently verify complete path ownership, source/bundle hashes, stopped-writing state, accepted owner inputs and no unlisted changes before treating run records as final evidence.

inherited_controls_still_required.summary: The module probe uses Path.is_relative_to(source/src) without an explicit resolve on each reported __file__ path.
inherited_controls_still_required.required_control: Retain the stopped-source snapshot and inspect the recorded module paths in the parent acceptance; do not use this runner as the sole proof of source provenance. This is unchanged from R2 and is not caused by the pytest argv delta.
